name: Metropolis of Boston Camp
description_short: An overnight Orthodox Christian camp run by the Greek Orthodox Metropolis of Boston on over 300 acres in Contoocook, NH. Campers entering grades 3-12 come for one 6-day summer session (Monday to Sunday), living in cabins grouped by age; weekend fall and winter camps serve grades 6-12.

sources.note: Session prices are the 1st-camper rate; 2nd camper $600, 3rd+ $550. Winter price depends on field trip ($325 or $375).

source.title: DATES & RATES - METROPOLIS OF BOSTON CAMP

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season. Today is 2026-10-13, so all 2026 summer, fall and winter sessions have already happened. Dates and fees for 2027 are not posted yet.
The address shown is the camp office in Brookline, MA, not necessarily where the campground is.

Summer prices go down for siblings: $650 for the 1st camper, $600 for the 2nd and $550 for the 3rd or more. Session prices use the 1st-camper rate. The page says the true cost is about $1200 per camper per week.

Winter camp has two field-trip options at different prices: Tour De Tooky for $325 and Ski Mountain for $375. Because of this, no single price is recorded for the winter sessions. Winter needs a $150 deposit and summer needs a $200 deposit.
The registration link is for winter camp, with registration opening Dec 1 (2025, for winter 2026). It may not be the link for summer registration.
The page asks winter applicants to select 'Requesting Fall Camp Financial Aid', which looks like a mistake on the page.

special_needs_notes: Nut-free facility; the kitchen can handle most nut, gluten and dairy allergies, and sets up a separate storage area for more serious allergies. Families should contact the office early about medical needs; a Camper Support page covers accommodations.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers must pass a swim test before waterfront activities. Lifeguards watch the waterfront at better than Red Cross ratios, no one swims without a lifeguard, and campers use a buddy system.
